components.E1: Observability eligibility: explicit current missing/unavailable/delayed/unknown-outcome evidence cannot sustain an active claim.
components.E2: Context eligibility: a context dimension that remains explicitly UNKNOWN across the visible determinate evidence cannot sustain a context-specific active claim.
components.E3: Conflict eligibility: only explicit L2 CONFLICTING context or incompatible determinate outcomes for the same opportunity may block active support; no statistical conflict detector.
components.E4: Currentness eligibility: only explicit HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE or OUTSIDE_CAPTURE_WINDOW currentness loss may mark historical support STALE; no age threshold is fitted because DEV staleness and supported recency overlap.

development_policy: DEV may be iterated for implementation/debugging only.
final_policy: L3 FINAL is scientifically spent by L4 and is forbidden for L5 treatment evaluation. A new protected blind split is required for confirmation.
hypothesis: A minimal Semantic Evidence Eligibility Gate before the frozen B9 recurrence fallback may reduce false active claims without reducing supported recall.
selection_rule: On both DEV and VALIDATION exact_state_accuracy must exceed T0.
On both DEV and VALIDATION false_promotion_rate must be lower than T0.
On both DEV and VALIDATION SUPPORTED recall must be at least T0.
correction_resurrection and deleted_active_return must remain zero.
At least one hard-failure class targeted by the treatment must strictly improve on each split.
No untargeted hard-failure class may worsen on either split.
Choose the qualifying treatment with the fewest atomic components; ties use lower VALIDATION false promotion, higher VALIDATION exact accuracy, fewer VALIDATION hard violations, then treatment id.
validation_policy: Freeze T0-T7 source, component definitions, evaluator, selection rule, and preregistration hash before exactly one VALIDATION execution.
